mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
